text: The Golden Isle is a small, treasure-covered island located directly southwest of the Port of Zem'lan, off the southwestern coast of Vol'dun. It was here that Pirate-King Zem'lan conducted the ritual that transformed his crew into undead skeletons using three cursed idols. In the present day, the Golden Isle is a forbidden island where Zem'lan hoards all of the treasures his crew has pillaged and plundered over countless years, so only he can enjoy them. Aside from Zem'lan, the only inhabitants of the isle are goldslaves, former crewmates forced to tend to the Pirate-King's treasures for eternity as punishment for attempting to steal some of the booty for themselves. Goldenvein is a mountain giant located on the expedition islands.
Gondola Go-Go are platforms for Gondolas located in Evermoon Commons and Artisan's Gallery of Suramar City in Suramar. The business is run by Deline.

__NOTOC__ Goramosh is a blue dragonspawn found in the Moonrest Gardens in the Dragonblight. He has been tasked with seeing to the negotiations between the blue dragonflight and the Ethereum. This involves meeting with Wind Trader Mu'fah. However, Goramosh is busy tending to a ritual upon his arrival, and orders one of his mage hunters to delay their meeting. He does not seem to care about Mu'fah's irritation at being made to wait for the audience, despite the constant complaints and even threats of calling off the meeting.

Goremaw the Devourer was a massive felhound and the personal hound of the Dark Titan, Sargeras. Sargeras must have cared deeply for his pet, for he sculpted its power, gifting its sharp fangs with enough shadow energy to pierce reality itself. One of the beast's most notable features was a potent withering essence that made its bites extremely deadly. When the Burning Legion invaded a new world, Goremaw would often accompany them, tearing enemy soldiers to shreds. Between battles, the felhound's eredar caretakers would collect the shadow energy dripping from its fangs, using it to craft powerful new weapons and reagents. It was created when the massive giant Grond, a mountain given life via the elemental powers of the titan Aggramar, fell against the Sporemounds. His corpse became the region of Gorgrond, while his head in Nagrand became known as the Throne of the Elements. Gorgrond is home to the and the industrial heart of the Iron Horde and their ancestral home, the Blackrock Foundry, lies near the northern coast. However, the industrial efforts of the Blackrock are dwarfed by the perpetual war that rages across the region. Gorian Falls is a sub-zone in eastern Ashran, on . This damp, winding zone features marauding saberon, swarms of podlings, and some very large flying insects, as well as a series of caves. Notably, the Star Root Tuber can be looted here.

The Gorian wars were a series of conflicts fought primarily between the ogres of the powerful Gorian Empire and the various orc clans and factions which also inhabited the world of Draenor as well as the alternate Draenor. When the planet's ogres rose from their humble conditions and formed the Gorian Empire thousands of years in the past, they became the dominant race on Draenor. Doing so, however, brought them into direct conflict with the disparate orc clans scattered across the world. The Gorian Empire fought the orc clans for centuries, killing many in retaliatory actions and enslaving countless more. Eventually, however, following a determined campaign by several orc clans, as well as
Gorkul the Unstoppable is an ogre located in Island Expeditions.

Gral's Call was a flagship of the Zandalari Golden Fleet, named for the great shark Gral, loa of the oceans. Under the command of Captain Zalkran, the ship may have been stationed with Zandalari forces in Pandaria, before being ambushed and destroyed by the Alliance on its return to Zandalar.
Great Coursers are stags found at Stonetalon Peak in the Stonetalon Mountains. Witch Doctor Jin'Zil wants their Courser Eyes to use in his "forest magic".

The Great Cat Spirit is a saber cat found in southern Moonglade. Unlike the similarly appearing Great Bear Spirit, it is not currently involved in any quests, and druids obtain their cat form without interacting with it. There was once a quest for druids to obtain their cat forms that involved this NPC and an escort quest in Darkshore, but the quest was removed in early 2005 because it was felt that this gave druids too much Cenarion Circle reputation too early. Killing it causes a loss of reputation with the Cenarion Circle. In the Emerald Nightmare raid, the Great Cat Spirit is found dead in the Nightmare version of Moonglade.

Grandmatron Tekla is an elderly orc quest giver found in Southfury Watershed and the grandmother of Raggaran. She was a powerful shaman in her time, but is no longer physically able to endure the elements, and she is thankful to the adventurer for the assistance. Finding and escorting her is part of Thonk's assignment to help the survivors of the flooding that occurred with the cataclysm. Upon reaching an area that would require wading in some shallow water, she casts Water Walking on both herself and the player. She will later cast Air Spirit's Boon on herself to allow her to fly the rest of the way to Raggaran. Grandmatron Tekla is somewhat difficult to find and her escort quest goes slowl
Gravellus is a mountain giant located in Island Expeditions.

:Were you looking for the giant trees known as World Trees? :Were you looking for the great trees known as kypari trees or dream trees? in Crystalsong Forest.]] The Great Trees are saplings of the World Tree Nordrassil and portals to the Emerald Dream. They are guarded by the green dragonflight and hold incredible power. Great Trees can be found in Feralas, Ashenvale, the Hinterlands, Duskwood, and Crystalsong Forest. The Dragons of Nightmare once emerged from them, and druid players can use them to emerge from the Emerald Dreamway.

The Great Lift was a tauren built elevator that allowed travel between the Barrens and Thousand Needles. However in recent times the quilboar in Southern Barrens have expanded their territory blocking the path from travelers. During the Cataclysm and flooding of Thousand Needles, the Great Lift was destroyed. The tauren Grish Longrunner and Brave Moonhorn that once resided here have gone missing, possibly either returning home or killed by the encroaching quilboar.

In the windswept canyons of the Stonetalon Mountains there lies the Great Maze, a massive labyrinth of stone. Unbeknownst to most of those who discover it, this maze is actually a powerful ley line pattern, for erosion has worn away all of the stone save that augmented by the strange lines of force, leaving behind the intricate rune-pattern used by rune-casters who master the Stone pattern.

Great Lionseye is a socketed gem made by jewelcrafting. The Great Seal is the upper part of the pyramid of Dazar'alor, King Rastakhan's palace in Zuldazar. It is the Horde's base of operations in Zandalar, hosting key leadership figures during their stay in the city and the wider Zandalari region. The name refers to its relationship with Uldir, as it was one of three seals keeping G'huun contained until the proper seal was destroyed by Mythrax the Unraveler. Giant concentric wheels used to turn around the outside of the palace, which were connected to a titan disk within. Now the disk is cracked and the wheels have stopped. Greatfather Winter's Sleigh is found near Greatfather Winter in Ironforge and near Great-father Winter in Orgrimmar. The sleigh is pulled by four Great Reindeer led by a Red-Nosed Reindeer. The sleigh, as well as the reindeers can all be ridden, and will periodically fly through their city.

Great Ohuna are ohuna that appear in the Nokhud Offensive to prevent players from leaving the zone. If a player tries to venture outside the borders of the Ohn'ahran Plains while inside the dungeon, they'll receive an 8-second warning: : : If they do not turn back before the warning expires, a Great Ohuna appears and picks them up. : The ohuna instantly transports them back to Maruukai and drops them in the city center before flying off and despawning.

Grel'borg the Miser is a two-headed ogre-mage in the service of Mug'thol, found in the Ruins of Alterac in the Hillsbrad Foothills. Count Remington Ridgewell wants the tiara Grel'borg possesses. Both Keeper Bel'dugur and Gerrig Bonegrip sought the magical star also in Grel'borg's possession.

Greenpaw Village is located in central Ashenvale, south of Raynewood Retreat, northeast of Silverwind Refuge, and northwest of the southern moonwell. It is the home of the Foulweald tribe, led by Chief Murgut and the shaman Oakpaw. Both Horde and Alliance adventurers frequently come to Greenpaw to battle the corrupted bearmen. The village has been partially destroyed by the Horde, with the furbolg inhabiting the conquered areas taken prisoner.
A Green Power Crystal is a type of power crystal that can be found throughout the Roiling Gardens in Un'Goro Crater.
Greaves of Forbidden Magics drop from Maut in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.
Gregg Needs Help! is a bonus objective on Island Expeditions. Its objective differs depending on the island.
Green Dragonflight Recruiter is a green dragonspawn located in the Quad in Algeth'ar Academy. He is accompanied by two Green Dragonflight Alums.

Green Dragonflight Alums are a pair of green drakonid located near Green Dragonflight Recruiter in the Quad in Algeth'ar Academy. One is standing next to Destinisera while another one is carrying a crate to Saphiredos' stall in Thaldraszus.
Greyheart Spellbinders are Broken found in Serpentshrine Cavern, using powerful magic to hold Leotheras the Blind.
Greystone Slingers are drogbar located in Highmountain Peak in Highmountain.

Grigsby was a member of the crew on the Bold Arva commanded by Flynn Fairwind that aided Mathias Shaw in his mission to check the costs of Zandalar for signs that the Banshee loyalists were on the continent. At one point, Grigsby was ordered to the helm.
Grimoire of Devour Magic (Rank 2) teaches rank 2 of Devour Magic to the warlock's felhunter.
Grimoire of the Felfrost Imp drops from Twinkle on the Darkmoon Island.

__NOTOC__ Grol the Destroyer is a demon warlord located at the Dreadmaul Hold in the northwest of the Blasted Lands. Although once an ogre, Grol has in fact become a demon. However, one day he was defeated, but lived on as a spirit, due to the tricky promise of immortality given to him by Razelikh.

Grong is an intelligent gorilla located in Zuldazar, the smartest of his kind. When war came to Zandalar, Bilgewater goblins attempted to poach the Da'kani gorillas despite the gorillas' best efforts to speak with them peacefully. In response to this, Grong joined forces with the Alliance, volunteering to become a living weapon against the Horde by converting his intelligence into pure strength with gnomish technology. Grong, having been increased in size and power but decreased in intelligence by gnomish engineering, fought the Horde in the Battle of Dazar'alor. After he was killed by Horde adventurers, he was risen as an undead by Bwonsamdi and turned against the Alliance, who in turn put
Growl is a druid ability and serves as the Guardian druid's taunt ability.

on Mechagon Island.]] Grumbol Grimhammer is a dwarf Alterac Valley battlemaster located at the entrance to Alterac Valley in the Hillsbrad Foothills. He defended the entrance during the Legion Invasions. During the Fourth War, the Horde sent forces to the Ruins of Alterac to repair it as a Horde base and encountered Grumbol Grimhammer there. Later, he appeared in the Faction Assaults as a rival, once again, to Usha Eyegouge. This rivalry carried over to Mechagon Island, where his forces in Grumbol's Hammers brawled with Usha's Eyegougers on the Western Spray.
Gruul's Shattered Toenail is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Grubby Needs Help! is a bonus objective on Island Expeditions. Its objective differs depending on the island.

Gryphadin was Brann Bronzebeard's trusty gryphon mount. He was purchased in Steamwheedle Port so that Brann could travel the across the islands of the South Seas. He is named after Muradin Bronzebeard, Brann's fallen brother. While visiting Plunder Isle, Gryphadin was turned to stone by a basilisk. Brann was able to restore him using a packet of magic dust.

Tinkers working among the windriders have long sought to recreate the gryphon's ability to see in the dark. Thus far, the best result they have achieved is these bulky goggles that grant the wearer low-light vision. The small batteries that power the goggles work only for one hour before they must be recharged with a fresh supply of phlogiston.
Guard Pearce is a human guard who normally stands by the bridge in Lakeshire in the Redridge Mountains, on the right-hand side when one is facing Lakeshire from the flight master.
Guard Ashlock is a human guard who patrols the bridge between the town of Lakeshire in the Redridge Mountains and the nearby flight master. He can be seen on the bridge during A Day in the Life.
Guardian Constructs are Nightborne constructs located in the Moonlit Landing and Gilded Market in the Court of Stars.

__NOTOC__ Gurak is an orc Alterac Valley battlemaster located at Farstriders' Square in the blood elven capital of Silvermoon City during the Call to Arms: Alterac Valley. He was only available during the monthly (Call to Arms: Alterac Valley).
Guron Twaintail is a Highmountain tauren enchanting trainer at Thunder Totem in Highmountain.

Gurgoth is a plague eruptor located in The Apothecarium in Undercity. He is the pet of Doctor Martin Felben. Gurgoth is killed by Thassarian and the Deathlord of the Ebon Blade who had infiltrated the city in order to rescue Koltira Deathweaver.

The Gurubashi Empire was once one of the most powerful forces of Azeroth, controlling much of the southern part of the eastern continents. It took its name from the strongest tribe of jungle trolls at the time, the Gurubashi. Their former capital of Zul'Gurub is located in Stranglethorn Vale. Eventually, this great nation splintered into separate tribes such as the Darkspear tribe. At the height of the Gurubashi Empire, the jungle trolls ruled over lands from Stranglethorn Vale to the Echo Isles.

The Gyro-Plank Bridge is a bridge constructed by B.O.O.M. to cross the gap over the Twisting Nether between the Blade's Edge Mountains and the Netherstorm. It is used mostly by those who are limited to walking the land, not yet having access to flight.

Gushing Wound was a new warrior ability that would come with Cataclysm, learned at level 83. It was first announced in the [https://blue.mmo-champion.com/topic/121703-cataclysm-class-preview-warrior/ Cataclysm warrior preview]. Gushing Wound would apply a bleed effect to the target. If the target moved, the bleed would gain an extra stack and refreshes its duration, up to a maximum of three stacks. The ability was planned to have no cooldown, cost 10 Rage, and have a 9-second duration. Gushing Wound was designed to be weaker than Rend with one stack, but better with three stacks, which will be reached when fighting a moving target.
Guyo Crystalgear is an engineering trainer located in the engineering corner of Hall of the Crescent Moon in Shrine of Two Moons.
The Gusting Portal is a portal found in Island Expeditions. It leads to an unnamed air elemental construction high above the island where Lord Sumar can be found.
The HK-8 Aerial Oppression Unit can be found circling above Junkwatt Depot on Mechagon Island. In alternate Mechagon Island, there is one circling over Junkwatt Depot and another circling Rustbolt.
Guuru the Mountain-Breaker is an ettin who can be encountered during Island Expeditions.
HK-3 Aerial Dissuasion Unit is an aerial unit flying along the Toothy Shallows on Mechagon Island.
HW in Warcraft context may represent one of the following: * Healing Wave, a shaman ability. * Holy Wrath, a paladin ability. * Hydraxian Waterlords, a faction of water elementals.

Halahk the Lifebringer was a human paladin who led the Circle of Holy Light, part of the resistance forces against Arthas Menethil in the ruins of Lordaeron. He was eventually killed by Arthas. The soul of Halahk was tortured within Frostmourne till he cursed the Light and forsook it. After Frostmourne was shattered, Halahk's spirit was freed, but his soul now wanders Icecrown Citadel as Halahk the Deathbringer. Frost death knights seeking to reforge the shards of Frostmourne into two new swords are forced to destroy Halahk's spirit before they are able to claim the shard that he is guarding. A missing fragment of Halahk's soul, crystallized as "The Holy Lifebringer", came into the Jailer's

A bijou is [http://dictionary.reference.com/browse/bijou "a small, exquisitely wrought trinket"]. As of patch 1.11 bijou are only used in A Bijou for Zanza, which can be repeated to gain reputation with the Zandalar Tribe. If you want to destroy a bijou, do not just destroy it like any other item (some have made this mistake.) Take it to Yojamba Isle and right-click the bijou when you are standing before the Altar of Zanza.

Haelga Slatefist was an elite level 85 Alterac Valley battlemaster located in the Lower City of the neutral Shattrath City during the Call to Arms: Alterac Valley. She used to sometimes attempt to start a conversation with the quiet Lylandor, who just replied with "Mmm". She also said she hadn't seen her brothers in ages. She was only available during the monthly (Call to Arms: Alterac Valley).
The Haggard War Veterans are human quest givers located in Lower City and the Terrace of Light in Shattrath City.

The Hall of Crafting is located inside Blackrock Depths, deep within Shadowforge City. It can be accessed either through the Domicile and past the Black Vault, or by going through a Shadowforge Key-locked gate and past the Dark Iron Highway. This rocky region is populated with groups of one elite golem and 3 non-elite Dark Iron dwarves. The area is a square staircase leading upward from the Black Anvil to the upper levels of the city. Fineous Darkvire patrols from one end of this area to the other. He is the NPC that drops Ironfel, which is required for a quest to obtain the Shadowforge Key. As the name implies, this is where the Dark Irons carve their golem protectors from soil and mud, lat

Hall of Binding is an area of Upper Blackrock Spire. It is accessed through the sealed door in the Dragonspire Hall by defeating all the orcs in that area. This is where several Blackrock channelers are keeping Pyroguard Emberseer, minion of Ragnaros, bound through force of magic. This magic can be disrupted, which will cause the orcs to attack in a frenzied panic, and Emberseer will break free of his elemental prison when all the channelers are dead. The Hall of Binding leads on to the infamous Rookery, but Emberseer has to be defeated for the door to open.

Hall of Blades is a subzone of Shattered Halls. Warchief Kargath Bladefist, the head of the Fel Horde, takes on all challengers in this suspended arena. Behind him is a short hallway where the Shattered Hand Executioner waits to decapitate captives.

The Hall of Antiquities is a section of the Nar'thalas Academy in Azsuna. It was here where the Tidestone of Golganneth was stored when Queen Azshara destroyed it, hence it serves as the epicenter for the magical explosion that ravaged the area.
Halewa Lightwind is a Highmountain tauren ghost located in Highmountain.

Halian Shlavahawk is a Highmountain tauren located in the Valley of Strength in Orgrimmar. Once he met the adventurer, he resolved to go to Ashenvale. He is later found deceased on the border between Ashenvale and Northern Barrens, exactly at Mor'shan Rampart's border end with the Fallen Sky Lake of the Ashenvale Forest.

The Hand of Iruxos is a powerful artifact capable of opening demonic portals, as well as closing any portals it previously opened. The Burning Blade cultists of Mannoroc Coven used it to summon a tide of demons into the world. The Hand of Iruxos was stolen from the Burning Blade and used by an adventurer to close their portals, though the circumstances differ between and retail. In Classic, Taiga Wisemane asked an adventurer to enter Thunder Axe Fortress and retrieve the Demon Box containing the Hand of Iruxos. __NOTOC__ Halthenis is a blood elf pet trainer located in the Rangers' Lodge in Farstriders' Square in Silvermoon City.

The Halls of Lightning is a five-man wing of Ulduar in the Storm Peaks. The Halls of Lightning is located in the eastern part of the enormous titan city of Ulduar. Here the treacherous Loken — a fallen servant of the Pantheon and former prime sentinel — mass-produced iron vrykul on behalf of his dark master's sinister plans. Loken himself guided his forces from his throne, guarded by storm elementals and fire elementals with his most powerful servants and commanders near his side. It is here that he made his last stand, before being defeated by the adventurers.

Hammon the Jaded is an archaeology trainer found in the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus, where he is seen talking to the Highborne Daros Moonlance. It is unknown whether he survived the Burning of Teldrassil or not.
__NOTOC__ Hallegosa is a member of the blue dragonflight who appears in Orgrimmar and Stormwind City. She escorts the wielder of Tarecgosa's Rest on their final ceremony.
Hall of the Fathers is a subzone of Shattered Halls. The entrance hall to the Shattered Halls is lined with statues of (presumably) the forefathers of the Fel Horde.

The Halls of Magic was an area in Dalaran. It was here that elven sorceresses and priests were tutored while in the city, before they could later finish their studies at arcane sanctums. It's unknown whether the area was rebuilt after the fall of Dalaran.
Halla Blurblades is a vision of a Highmountain tauren located in Highmountain. She appears upon interacting with the Ancient Spirit Drum.

The Hall of the Seasons is the ground level of the interior of the Temple of Five Dawns on the Wandering Isle. In the center is a massive statue of Liu Lang on the back of Shen-zin Su. While the chamber existed in the Mists of Pandaria version of the Wandering Isle, it was made its own subzone as part of the monks' Class Hall in Legion; in the class hall version, the artifact forge, the Forge of the Roaring Mountain, is located on Shen-zin Su's head, and a pair of Teleportation Mandalas on either side of the statue allow access to the middle and upper levels. Iron-Body Ponshu can be found here.

The Hand of Naxxramas is a shade located south of Slaughter Square in Stratholme. It is hunted down during Wards of the Dread Citadel. Breaking a Ward of Naxxramas and destroying a Scourge crystal at Crusaders' Square will alert the shade and cause it to flee after five minutes. It is hiding behind a gate, preparing to escape through a portal. The only way to kill it is with the power of an Argent Dawn Commission, using To Dust.
Hannah Akeley is a Forsaken reagent vendor located in the Magic Quarter in Undercity.
__NOTOC__ Harbinger Balthazad is a wandering Forsaken quest giver located in the Undercity. He was present during the Battle for Lordaeron and could be evacuated out of the Undercity.

Handfuls of Summer Petals are rewarded 10 each from the following quests during the Midsummer Fire Festival: * Stealing Darnassus's Flame * Stealing Ironforge's Flame * Stealing Orgrimmar's Flame * Stealing Silvermoon's Flame * Stealing Stormwind's Flame * Stealing the Exodar's Flame * Stealing the Undercity's Flame * Stealing Thunder Bluff's Flame Can also be bought for from Midsummer Merchant or Midsummer Supplier in the capital cities during the Midsummer Fire Festival.
Hanye Chargefeather is a Highmountain tauren found on a wooden balcony halfway down the cliffside southwest of Thunder Totem in Highmountain, butting heads with Muun Windchest.

Harbinger Raloam is a large obsidian destroyer located in the Ruins of Khintaset in Uldum during the Assault in Uldum. Three Aqir Voidcasters can be found casting Obsidian Empowerment on him. Once they have been dealt with, he can be fought.

Harlan Bagley is a human quest giver located in Trade District in Stormwind City. He can be found inside his shop, Lionheart Armory, which is located on the north end of the district center. He was present among the concerned citizens in Trader's Hall when the Veiled Hand and the Uncrowned infiltrated the city.

Hargh Silvereye is a friend of Brann Bronzebeard living in Stormwind. He is well informed of the attitudes of the city's citizens towards the Alliance, Theramore, and Jaina Proudmoore (and her father). He also knows a bit about the secret Stormwind Assassins. Brann once visited him at the Pig and Whistle to learn a bit about the city.
Harpy Queens are harpy creeps that can be encountered in the Barrens tileset. One of them captured the Stonetalon wyvern flight before the Horde arrived to the Stonetalon Mountains.
Hark Sharpeye is a Highmountain tauren standing in a hut slightly southwest of the lower level of Thunder Totem in Highmountain. He is also seen during the Legion Assaults.
Haren Stonepath is a Highmountain tauren stable master found on the Snowblind Mesa in Highmountain.
Harpy Totems are totems located at the Harpy Roost on Exile's Reach. Though their presence empowers the harpies, they're not particularly powerful, so they can easily be burned.

Harmen was a member of the crew on the Bold Arva commanded by Flynn Fairwind that aided Mathias Shaw in his mission to check the coasts of Zandalar for signs that the Banshee loyalists were on the continent. He was a gunner, being in charge of the defense of the ship.

The Hath'ar are undead nerubians located in Zul'Drak led by Malas the Corrupter. Originally aboard the flying necropolis Kolramas, the Hath'ar and their base of operations were shot down from the sky by the Drakkari tribe. Unfortunately for the Argent Crusade forces nearby the crash did not kill all the Scourge within. After emerging from the crash, Malas the Corrupter ordered the Hath'ar to start raising up any dead they could get their nasty claws on, including fallen crusaders of the Argent Crusade, which they used against them. In response to this Sergeant Moonshard has called for the death of the Hath'ar Necromagus forces. The Hath'ar have taken over Drak'Sotra trapping the Argent Crusa
Harum Grayfeather is a Highmountain tauren innkeeper found in the Tradewind Roost at Skyhorn in Highmountain.

Haruspices are key members of the Zandalar tribe. By communion with animals and giving them up to the spirits when needed, they give the tribe divine guidance. In times past, the haruspex's insight and wisdom gave the Zandalari an edge in the wars against the splintered tribes of the Gurubashi. The Zandalar know not of druidic ways; nature is to be shaped by their need, not the other way around. Still, a haruspex is the one of them most in tune with nature, and rightly so. To give up the ghost of a beast is to know what it is to be one of them. That is the real power of nature. The ultimate symbol of a haruspex's power is what they wear. The Hatching Corpsefly Egg is obtained by looting a Small Corpsefly Egg and waiting three days.

.]] The haunted isle is a medium-sized island near the coast of northern Stranglethorn Vale. Located a short distance south of Yojamba Isle and northwest of The Vile Reef. The haunted isle is not a proper subzone and is only tentatively called such by Baron Revilgaz. The Hearthsteed, a mount rumored to be chiseled from the same rare mineral as the Hearthstone itself, bears a striking resemblance to every adventurer's most useful item. The Heartsbane Coven is a coven of witches who has recently appeared in Kul Tiras and terrorizes the people of Drustvar. Daio the Decrepit had warlock adventurers retrieve some of these crystals for him. Following the Cataclysm, the Twilight's Hammer cultists defeated the demons and took control of the area.

HexSweeper is a minigame that can be played on the Darkmoon Arcade Console at the Darkmoon Faire. When the game is launched, a grid of hexagons will appear on the ground behind the console. A number of hexagon tiles, as indicated by a counter at the top of the grid, are "mined" and will explode if the player runs over them, resulting in instant death (and a subsequent corpse run). Running over any other tile will cause it to display the number of mines adjacent to it. The goal is to use these number hints to find the locations of the mined tiles and click on them to place a white flag. Once all the mines are flagged and all the safe tiles are revealed, you win.

The History of Warcraft is a part of the Warcraft universe. An updated version of Warcraft's history is presented in World of Warcraft: Chronicle.

Hive'Zora was a silithid nest in western Silithus. The nest was destroyed at the end of the third invasion of the Burning Legion when Sargeras tried to destroy Azeroth through Silithus.

Most honor talents were class-specific, and a majority of choices depended on specialization. Honor talents offered a further level of customization beyond class and specialization selection, and could be changed very easily and cheaply. The House of the Makers is located within the settlement at Bael Modan. Here, scholars read, copy and compare notes and clues, binding the information into books and sending copies back to dwarves in Theramore. One goal is to send information back to Khaz Modan and the remaining dwarves there. The dwarves in Kalimdor wish to bring their entire race to the continent to found a new homeland based on their discovered history, but the dwarves back in the mountains of Khaz Modan will likely prove to be stubborn.

House Proudmoore is one of four noble houses that rule Kul Tiras. Masters of the sea and commanders of Azeroth's finest navy, the distinguished Proudmoore family has led Kul Tiras for decades from their seat of power in Boralus. Their seat is Proudmoore Keep, located in the city of Boralus. House Proudmoore rules Kul Tiras, commanding both the military and the guard in the form of the Proudmoore Admiralty and the Proudmoore Guard.

The hozen are a monkey-like race that live in Pandaria and various islands of the Great Sea. Short-lived and immature, they are a passionate and playful race, mischievous pranksters that "act like a group of 14 year old boys running around together in the jungle." The hozen are native to Pandaria, and are found all over the continent. Mostly a wild and independent race, hostile to any who wander into their hunting grounds, one tribe of forest hozen were befriended by the Horde after adventurers earned their grudging respect. Equipped with machine guns and weapons from the Horde, this hozen tribe were trained and recruited to join the battle against the Alliance and their new allies.

The house of Salonar was one of the seven greatest noble families of Quel'Thalas. As such, it had a seat in the Convocation of Silvermoon, the ruling power of the high elven kingdom. After the Third War, it is possible that the surviving Salonars changed the family's name as many quel'dorei did when they became sin'dorei.

Human Refugees can be found residing at the Refugee Caravan in southern Terokkar Forest. Many more of these men and women make their home and new living in the Lower City of Shattrath City.

Northshire Abbey remains dedicated to recruiting and training any citizens brave enough to help keep the peace. Huge, Sharp Teeth! is an ability used by Darkmoon Rabbit during a Pet Battle.

Huginn is a raven located in Stormheim. Huginn and Muninn once had a jewel called the Raven's Eye, created for them by Havi, that allowed them to read and understand any language. But Kur'talos Ravencrest tricked them into giving it to him in exchange for candy. Upon placing the Aegis of Aggramar, he briefly appears flying in the Portrait Room in Dalaran. He also appears in Deliverance Point on the Broken Shore.

The Human Refugees was a group of human villagers, militia and soldiers in Lordaeron. This resistance force also included dwarves led by a mountain king, high elves led by Jennalla Deemspring and two human archmages. Several months after the end of the Third War, Arthas Menethil returned to Lordaeron, proclaimed himself king and sought to rid it of humanity. The refugees tried to get away to Dalaran through mountain passes. They were allied with the paladin groups of Circle of Holy Light‎, Defenders of Justice‎, and Crippling Force‎, but they were all wiped out by the undead forces.
Hrul Sharphoof is a Highmountain tauren leatherworking trainer found in a hut just south of the upper level of Thunder Totem in Highmountain.

Hungering Destroyer is a boss located in Castle Nathria. A devourer of titanic size, it breaks into the Purloined Stores to devour the anima which Sire Denathrius gathered for the Jailer. This is a one-phase fight that is typically seen as a gear check, with very high tank damage and raid-wide damage, but also tests players' ability to move and react to mechanics quickly and cleanly.

The hunter is a damage dealing class that can engage in either melee or ranged combat. Hunters who are master marksmen use a plethora of different shots to take down their prey, from venomous barbs and magical projectiles to explosive volleys and penetrating powershots, while those who focus on melee combat do so with polearms, executing deft flanking maneuvers and being particularly skilled at throwing their weapon. Hunters are also masters of survival, and their familiarity with traps and misdirection can allow them to manipulate their quarry's attentions, leading them into deadly ambushes or camouflaging themselves so well that even the sharpest-eyed of foes cannot fix their aim upon them

A hunter trainer is an NPC that offers hunters the opportunity to train abilities and reset their talent points (including their pets'). Pet trainers could previously teach those pet abilities that the hunter had not yet learned. Since Patch 3.0.2, the way that pets operate has been drastically changed. Pet trainers now exist to allow the hunter to re-spec his or her pet's talents. Unlike player character re-specs, pet re-specs are always free. The hunter must have a pet summoned in order to alter pet talents. See Hunter pets 3.0.2 changes for a list. Their whole lot in life is to sell zeppelins to wayward seafarers whose ships were destroyed by perilous hurricanes common to these waters.[http://www.battle.net/war3/maps/war3xbonusmaps7.shtml]

.]] Hyenas are large carnivorous beasts found in the most barren areas of Kalimdor. They are most dangerous when traveling in packs. Rotting corpses attract hyenas and from feeding on the dead they often have an ability to inflict dangerous diseases on those who fight them. Hyenas possess tremendous strength in their jowls. Centaur hunters in the Barrens and Desolace often keep them as pets, while they also serve as mounts for Uldum's desert pygmies and Vol'dun's vulpera. Hyenas are skinnable. They are found in the Barrens, Desolace, Tanaris, Blasted Lands, Dragonblight, Uldum, Townlong Steppes, and Vol'dun.

I'lalai was an old city, formerly on the shores of Stranglethorn Vale, that was part of the Gurubashi Empire. It was Min'loth's seat of power where he performed his mysterious rituals.

Hymn of Hope was a channeled priest mana regeneration ability. You recite a Holy hymn, restoring hope to those in despair. The Hymn restores 2% mana to 3 nearby low mana friendly party or raid targets every 2 sec for 8 sec, and increases their total maximum mana by 15% for 8 sec. The Hymn prefers healers, and healers will always be picked before non-healers, regardless of how much mana they have. The Priest must channel to maintain the spell.

Hylan is a bishop within the Church of the Holy Light. He is one of the three bishops who have formed their own power bases within the council, one of the true powers behind the Church. Despite being one of the oldest remaining bishops, Hylan is still extremely active, and forceful enough to cow many younger men by sheer volume. A strong proponent of the old Church ways, Hylan disapproves of fraternizing with nonhumans and even with nonbelievers. He feels the Church would be better off concentrating on its own people and letting the rest of the world suffer, and says this at every opportunity. Hydrophobia is an achievement that is awarded for defeating in Temple of the Jade Serpent without being hit by the following abilities on Heroic difficulty: * Corrupted Water, the pulsing AoE that deals damage to anyone standing in any water. * Hydrolance, Maru's primary AoE ability in phase 1. * Wash Away, the phase 2 rotating AoE water blast.
I've Got the Power is a player vs. player achievement earned for winning Temple of Kotmogu while controlling all 4 Orbs of Power.

I've Got 9999 Problems but a Bone-White Primal Raptor Ain't One is a Feat of Strength awarded for colecting 9,999x Giant Dinosaur Bone from the dinosaurs on Isle of Giants, then turning them in to Ku'ma in the quest A Mountain of Giant Dinosaur Bones.

The Hyper-Compressed Ocean is an achievement reward from Secret Fish and Where to Find Them, and is placed directly into the Toy Box on completion. It acts as a fishing pool which player can fish from and lasts for 15 minutes with a 60 minute cooldown. Interestingly, the toy is treated as a 'school' of fish, meaning that players who have never fished from a school will receive The Old Gnome and the Sea upon successfully catching something from a Hyper-Compressed Ocean.

Hyper Organic Light Originator is a racial ability for all mechagnomes, creating two Organic Light duplicates that taunt enemies. Two copies of the player will spawn next to them with 10% of their maximum health and auto-attack hostile targets, temporarily dropping their threat, but inflict very limited damage. They last for about 15 seconds. Mechagnome mage players sometimes use Mirror Image and monks use Storm, Earth, and Fire in conjunction with this ability in order to maximize damage output and effectiveness in difficult encounters.

Iceflow Lake is a medium-sized lake located in western Dun Morogh. Although the altitude and the frigid temperature ensures that the lake continually freezes over, the dwarves of Brewnall Village keep a hole clear of ice in order to access fresh water and provide fishing opportunities. Paxton Ganter is located here. The lake is dominated by a couple of large islands located in its center. These islands are best avoided, as they are home to a large pack of ravenous wolves, led by the worg Timber.

Icecrown, also known as Ice Crown, is a region composed of mostly Icecrown Glacier and the immediate area around it. Icecrown is dark and inescapably cold, the mountains and glacier that fill the valleys between them so hardened and desecrated that the ice has gone black with corruption. Walls and gates and massive walkways made of saronite lace the ground and connect the various Scourge fortresses and citadels. It's been a place of evil since the first Lich King crashed down into the ice and made it the center of Scourge activity, the place from which nearly all blight and undeath ultimately flows. Icepine Point is a small ridge with a hunter's camp watching over the Howling Hills in Highmountain. The encampment is a spur of the safari stationed at Nesingwary's Retreat. No services are offered at this camp, of which there are five NPCs (see below). The player is eventually sent here during the course of the chain of Hemet Nesingwary side quests in Highmountain. Two of the camp's inhabitants, Emily Wells and Maruul, are stationed on a rock ledge overlooking a trail that passes by the camp and leads across a bridge towards Snowblind Mesa.

The Icetusk tribe is an ice troll tribe located on the Dread Chain and assault other islands looking for :Azerite. Originating in Northrend, they resisted the Lich King's promises and set out on huge canoes to find salvation. And yet, all they found was hardship and despair. In dark times, they turned to necromancy, and thus the tribe has lived on, but only barely. They are referred to as island trolls.

The Icon of Wisdom is the racial icon of the night elves, and symbolizes the knowledge that comes with their incredible longevity. The crest feature's an owl's head which strongly resembles a warden's helmet, as well as a moon glaive bearing a crescent moon design, representing their faith in Elune. Beneath are a pair of crossed arrows accented with black feathers, a shield and a bed of fallen leaves.
Idol of Ferocity is a relic that drops from Lord Roccor in Blackrock Depths. It improves Claw (druid ability) and Rake.

The Icy Depths is a cave located beneath the Crusaders' Coliseum. It is a small section of Azjol-Nerub directly under the Argent Tournament Grounds. After the final challenge of the Trial of the Crusader has been completed, the floor of the Coliseum shatters and the challengers fall into a subterranean lake. Anub'arak, in his second resurrection by the Lich King, can be found here, awaiting the challengers. After Anub'arak's defeat, Tirion Fordring proudly lauds his slayers and offers teleportation to Dalaran by one of the Argent Crusade's mages.

The Idol of Aviana was long stored at the Shrine of Aviana in Mount Hyjal. Druids are able to assume their flight form by utilizing its connection to the Wild God Aviana. During the third invasion of the Burning Legion, it was stolen by the nathrezim Infazzar the Shade. In addition to cutting the druids off from their flight form, Infazzar corrupted the idol as part of a plot to assault Dalaran with fel harpies. Infazzar was slain by Thisalee Crow and the Archdruid of the Dreamgrove and the corrupted idol brought to the Dreamgrove, where the assembled druids were able to purify it of Infazzar's corruption.

The Icon of the Lich King is the sigil of the Scourge. Its azure coloration and icy ornamentation symbolize the frigid homeland of the undead horde in Northrend. At the icon's center is the now-shattered runeblade Frostmourne, the former blade of the Lich King Arthas Menethil. The frost-covered hammers flanking the blade represent the Scourge's endless capacity for warfare, as well as their construction of the saronite citadel Icecrown and the dread Necropoli that shepherded the endless armies of the dead and served as hubs of unspeakable torment upon the living. Illidan's Naga consists of various tribes of naga who followed Illidan Stormrage into Outland. They controlled several of the watery areas of the shattered planet, including much of Zangarmarsh, and were led by Illidan's naga lieutenant, Lady Vashj, who ruled from Coilfang Reservoir in Zangarmarsh.

IMBA (or imba) is an abbreviation for "imbalanced" that is often used within the realm of online gaming (especially on online message boards). It generally refers to a tactic or ability that is considered unfairly powerful.

Illidari Point is a staging ground for Illidan's loyal demons. It is located in the western part of Shadowmoon Valley. The ruins themselves are originally of draenei make, but its given name has been lost to the times. In Warlords of Draenor, this area does not exist, being mountains in the Spires of Arak region.
